name: dotnet-azure-lessons
description: Checkable rules for .NET, Azure, and PowerShell work by phase, plus macOS and agent-sandbox situations, learned from past corrections, with a read-only reviewer agent.

interface.shortDescription: Recurrence-prevention rules for .NET, Azure, and PowerShell
interface.longDescription: Skills for design, coding, Visual Studio Remote UI, PowerShell, debugging, testing, documentation, CI/CD, PR/issue handling, .NET development on macOS, and agent sandbox troubleshooting. Every rule has a check and a reason learned from past corrections. Includes a read-only reviewer agent.
defaultPrompt: Review this .NET change against the lessons checks before I report it done.
